# The record documents both readers of inventory_guide_excluded_keys.txt are
# given, and the outcome each expects of them (review finding on PR #654). The
# readers are test/examples' readExcludedFixtureKeys, through parseExcludedKeys,
# and test/site's readExcludedFields, through parseExcludedFields: neither
# test package may import the other, so each holds its own copy of the parser, and
# this one table is what says the two accept and reject the same documents for the
# same reasons. Both run it, each against its own copy. A case added here is
# therefore a promise both readers keep, and a copy that grew to accept a document
# the other rejects fails on the spot instead of letting one half of PRD #571's
# promise hold while the other lets a field through.
#
# A case is one line of `<outcome> | <document>`, and `\n` in the document is a
# newline. The outcome is either the records the document holds, each spelled as
# the list spells it (`key: <field>` or `prefix: <prefix>`) and joined by ` ; `,
# or `rejected: <reason>`, the reason being the one the reader's error names:
# `malformed` (no `: ` or no name), `unknown kind`, `comment` (a `#` on a record
# line), `duplicate` (a record an earlier line already wrote) or `empty half` (a
# list with no key, or no prefix, which would leave one half of the checks
# excluding nothing).
#
# A document accepted here holds both halves, since a list of keys alone is
# rejected as an empty half: that is why every accepted case below writes a key
# and a prefix.
key: AccessPolicies ; prefix: ZookeeperConnectString | key: AccessPolicies\nprefix: ZookeeperConnectString
key: AccessPolicies ; prefix: ZookeeperConnectString | # the account's principals\n\nkey: AccessPolicies\n\n# a cluster's hosts\nprefix: ZookeeperConnectString\n
key: Endpoints ; prefix: BootstrapBroker |   key: Endpoints\n\n   prefix: BootstrapBroker
rejected: malformed | Endpoint
rejected: malformed | key:
rejected: malformed | prefix:
rejected: unknown kind | field: AccessPolicies\nprefix: ZookeeperConnectString
rejected: comment | key: AccessPolicies # the account's principals\nprefix: ZookeeperConnectString
rejected: duplicate | key: Endpoint\nprefix: BootstrapBroker\nkey: Endpoint
rejected: empty half | key: AccessPolicies
rejected: empty half | prefix: ZookeeperConnectString
rejected: empty half | # a list of nothing but a comment
